patch_description:
This version keeps the strong antipodal spherical-code formulation from the current program, ensuring a fixed diameter of 2 and reducing the problem to minimizing the maximum absolute inner product among seven lines.

It improves the optimization through a multi-stage continuation schedule: lower soft-max sharpness first finds a well-separated global arrangement, while higher sharpness stages focus progressively on the limiting pairwise contacts. A deterministic final active-pair polishing stage directly reduces the true maximum squared inner product. Multiple seeded restarts retain reproducibility while selecting the best code found.
